dataset_label: Historical reanalysis + PSA census — not station observations
weight_rationale: The full composite index is unavailable because verified vegetation and built-up layers are absent. The active heat-only screening index is 100 × clip((heat index - 27)/27, 0, 1). No environmental values or weights are invented. Categories are configurable analytical bands, not official alert thresholds.
exposure_method: Assign the 2020 PSA census population of each city once to its selected-time heat-only screening category. This is geographic co-location of a historical population baseline and ERA5-Land point estimates, not measured individual exposure. Density uses generalized historical boundary area and is approximate.
heat_index_method: NWS Rothfusz regression in Fahrenheit, with the preliminary simple formula and low/high humidity adjustments. Convert to Celsius. Shaded, light-wind conditions; not surface temperature or a medical risk model.
simulation_method: Recalculate heat index from changed temperature and humidity, then the heat-only screening score. Population-density changes scale the historical population at fixed area. Vegetation and built-up controls are unavailable because no verified baseline exists. The original composite model is not active.
limitations: ERA5-Land is gridded historical reanalysis, not a city weather station or neighborhood measurement.
Multiple cities can share the same approximately 11 km weather grid. Point samples are not citywide averages.
Population is the official 2020 census baseline, not an estimate of the population in 2025.
Generalized 2023 reference geometry is not current legal geography; census and boundary vintages differ, including Makati/Taguig changes.
Vegetation and built-up measurements are unavailable; the full composite exposure index is disabled.
Heat-only score thresholds are exploratory analytical bands, not medical or government classifications.
Forecasts are retrospective experiments from the dataset endpoint, not live weather forecasts.
City samples sharing a grid are not independent observations; reported city correlations are descriptive.
Heat exposure does not establish individual health risk or causal intervention effects.
